name: desa-wonowoso
description: Website Desa Wonowoso converted to Express.js

scripts.stop: node -e "const { execSync } = require('child_process'); try { const pids = execSync('lsof -t -i:3000', { stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }).toString().trim(); if (pids) { execSync('kill ' + pids); console.log('Server stopped on port 3000'); } else { console.log('No server running on port 3000'); } } catch (error) { console.log('No server running on port 3000'); }"
